title: Project Accuracy Contract Evidence Ingestion & Governance Template Closeout

qualified_capability.purpose: Provide a reusable, machine-checkable external evidence boundary for project-specific groundwater-head/drawdown application-accuracy policy before values are mapped into the canonical runtime/coupler contract.
qualified_capability.source_integrity: Each admitted claim is bound to an explicit evidence-basis classification and a SHA-256 source digest.
qualified_capability.claim_separation: Application and temporal policy require distinct claim identities and distinct provenance IDs, while the same governing document may contain both as distinct clause-level claims.
qualified_capability.direct_budget_mapping: An externally governed direct temporal head-error budget may be deterministically reparameterized as A_temporal = direct_budget_cm / H_app_cm only when 0 < direct_budget_cm <= H_app_cm.

qualification.positive_direct_budget_mapping_oracle: PASS: synthetic 10 cm application requirement and 2 cm direct temporal budget map to A_temporal=0.2 and 2 cm budget

architecture_invariants.2: PASS kernel remains independent of files, formats and parsing; evidence ingestion belongs to an external runtime/coupler adapter boundary
architecture_invariants.3: PASS external application policy/provenance is kept distinct from physical parameters, dynamic state, forcing and solver state
architecture_invariants.9: PASS time horizon is explicit project evidence; no day/month/year computational assumption is introduced
architecture_invariants.10: PASS no fixed coupling-window duration is encoded; temporal allocation is an accuracy allocation, not a timestep prescription
architecture_invariants.11: PASS coupling accuracy policy is represented explicitly as governed coupling/runtime evidence
architecture_invariants.12: PASS_WITH_SCOPE prediction-accuracy policy remains separate from hard head/flux interface conservation; this workunit does not alter interface equations
architecture_invariants.13: PASS mass conservation remains absolute and untouched
architecture_invariants.15: PASS evidence governance introduces no structural extra SWAP trajectory cost
architecture_invariants.23: PASS numerical/application accuracy policy remains explicitly separate from physical options
architecture_invariants.26: PASS project identity, QOI, scope, horizon, provenance, policy mode and fail-closed rejection reasons are explicit and diagnosable
architecture_invariants.28: PASS project/regulator composition and evidence ownership stay outside the SWAP kernel
architecture_invariants.29: PASS no hidden project, MODFLOW, file-format, calendar or timestep dependency is introduced into kernel code
architecture_invariants.30: PASS schema, governance semantics, positive mappings and adversarial forbidden substitutions were explicitly qualified before closeout
